title: Restore local validation capability for model-controlled sessions across the L9 node fleet
objective: Remove the recurring friction observed during SEO-Bot PR #61 remediation: a model-controlled Claude Code session cannot install @quantum-l9 packages by governance policy, so every session starts with zero local validation capability and each agent improvises a workaround. Make the policy-compliant path canonical, wired, and shared by all four node repos.
success_criteria: A fresh model-controlled session in SEO-Bot, Website-Bot or LLM-Router can run the repo's blocking gates (typecheck + tests) without a PAT and without hand-built stubs.
`make pr-check` exits 0 on a clean checkout of main, so it can serve as the pre-PR go/no-go it advertises itself to be.
The SessionStart hook in SEO-Bot actually fires (registered in .claude/settings.json), proven by its output appearing in a new session.
ensure-npm-auth.sh no longer advises a remediation that is structurally impossible on a model surface; it names the local-link path instead.
All four @quantum-l9 dependencies resolve from local sibling sources with zero hand-written stubs.
npm run verify:all completes non-interactively instead of hanging in vitest watch mode.
AGENTS.md no longer contradicts ci.yml on lockfile/npm ci.
l9-plan and the other governance skills needed for this work are reachable via the Skill tool in a fresh session.
A fresh session rooted at a multi-repo workspace lists l9-plan among its invocable skills with no manual reconciliation step.

in: SEO-Bot: .claude/settings.json hook registration, scripts/ensure-npm-auth.sh messaging, package.json verify:all/test scripts, AGENTS.md lockfile prose
Cursor-Governance: a reusable link-local-packages command shared by all node repos, plus skill-sync coverage
Website-Bot and LLM-Router: adopt the same hook registration + link command
Biome baseline so authors can prove zero new findings without hand-diffing against main
out: Weakening surface_trust / resolve_secret / authed_npm PAT policy in any way
Changing CI workflow definitions or branch protection
Refactoring build-intelligence or any product code

todos.task: Write ops/scripts/link_local_l9_packages.sh in Cursor-Governance: for each @quantum-l9 dep in the caller repo's package.json, locate the sibling source checkout, build it if needed, and install it via a file: override into node_modules WITHOUT mutating the committed package.json or package-lock.json. Emit a machine-readable report of linked vs unresolved packages.

Add a package-name to source-repo map (bot-interop -> Website-Bot/packages/bot-interop, llm-router -> LLM-Router, infisical-config -> infisical-config, graphiti-memory-client -> l9-graphiti-memory) as data the link script reads, so the mapping is declared once rather than rediscovered per session.

Register the existing SessionStart hook by creating SEO-Bot/.claude/settings.json with a hooks.SessionStart entry pointing at .claude/hooks/session-start.sh, mirroring the working Cursor-Governance settings.json shape.

Rewrite the fallback branch of SEO-Bot/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh: when NODE_AUTH_TOKEN is absent (the normal model-surface case), invoke the governance link script instead of printing advice to fix AWS. Keep soft-fail and exit 0 semantics.

Correct scripts/ensure-npm-auth.sh so the terminal WARN states that model-controlled surfaces are denied a PAT by design (surface_trust) and directs the reader to the link script, rather than telling them to make AWS resolve the ref.
Fix the verify:all hang: point it at a non-interactive runner (vitest run) and include the real blocking gate (tsc) so verify:all actually mirrors CI.
Correct AGENTS.md section 1 and 5 where they state 'no lockfile' and 'never npm ci'; ci.yml commits a lockfile and runs npm ci. Add it to the existing known-stale-prose list or fix the rule outright.

Make `make pr-check` pass on a clean tree. It runs `npx biome check .`, which reports 13 errors / 174 warnings on pristine origin/main, so the repo's own advertised pre-PR gate cannot go green and no agent can use it as a go/no-go. Either clear the findings or commit a baseline/suppression so pr-check is a real signal.

Make governance skill availability automatic for model-controlled sessions. The corpus is NOT supplied by setup_claude_code_plugins.sh's marketplace path and is NOT editable via the account-synced registry; it is produced by ops/scripts/reconcile_claude_l9_skills.py from ops/generated/skill-registry.json. Nothing invokes it in a multi-repo workspace, because the only registered SessionStart hook is project-scoped to Cursor-Governance and this workspace root is the multi-repo parent directory, not the governance clone. Register a USER-scope $HOME/.claude/settings.json SessionStart hook (or run `make claude-install` once per container) so the reconciler runs unconditionally. Verified manually: reconciler created 51/51 symlinks with 0 conflicts and took effect without a session restart.
Roll T3 and T4 to Website-Bot and LLM-Router, which have .claude/ but no settings.json and no hook at all.

Reconcile the two skill registries. 4 account-synced skills (l9-ci-gap-auditor, l9-ci-repair, l9-github-ci, l9-pr-analysis) exist ONLY in the Anthropic account registry with no counterpart in Cursor-Governance/skills, while 47 repo skills existed only on disk. Decide the SSOT per skill and eliminate the divergence so a session's capability is predictable.

disconfirming_questions: Do local sibling sources actually match the versions package.json pins? Observed: bot-interop 1.1.0 satisfies ^1.1.0 and LLM-Router 1.3.0 matches the exact pin — but this is a point-in-time match that can drift.
Is linking local sources a correctness hazard — could an agent validate against source newer than the published artifact CI installs?
Does the fleet actually keep all sibling repos checked out side by side, or was that specific to this session's workspace?
Is the two-package stub gap real, or does some other checkout already provide infisical-config and graphiti-memory-client?
Would registering the hook slow session start enough to matter?
Is `make pr-check` red on main by oversight, or deliberately, pending the enforce-biome:true flip described in docs/runbooks/BIOME_INSTANTIATION.md?
Is the account-synced registry deliberately a curated subset for model surfaces, making full 51-skill reconciliation an anti-goal?
assumed_false_ifs: If sibling repos are not reliably co-located, the link script must clone on demand and the effort estimate for T1 roughly doubles.
If local source can diverge from the published version, the link script must print the version delta loudly and the plan needs a drift guard todo.
If the skill sync list is generated remotely rather than by setup_claude_code_plugins.sh, T9 targets the wrong file and needs re-scoping.
If Biome's error count is not stable across versions, a raw count baseline is the wrong mechanism and T8 should use a suppression file.
If the biome debt is a tracked, deliberate migration with an owner and a date, T8 becomes 'do not touch — document the expected count' rather than a cleanup.
If the 8-skill synced set is a deliberate curation rather than drift, T9 should reconcile only an approved allowlist and T11 becomes a documentation task.
stress_test.blast_radius: Development-environment and documentation surfaces only. No product code, no CI workflow, no branch protection, no secret policy. The one behavioral change to a committed script is verify:all, which currently cannot complete non-interactively. Linked packages live in gitignored node_modules; package.json and package-lock.json stay untouched, so nothing can leak into a commit.
stress_test.rollback: Delete .claude/settings.json to unwire the hook; git revert the ensure-npm-auth.sh, package.json and AGENTS.md edits; remove the governance link script. Each todo is independently revertible and none is load-bearing for CI.

shared_causes: no-policy-compliant-local-install-path — the single dominant cause; governance deliberately denies a PAT to model surfaces, yet no sanctioned alternative exists, so every agent improvises

canonical-gate-is-red-on-main — `make pr-check` runs `biome check .` which fails with 13 errors on pristine main, so the one command the repo offers as a pre-PR gate is unusable and every agent substitutes an ad-hoc check
hook-written-but-never-wired — a correct SessionStart hook exists in SEO-Bot but no settings.json registers it, so it is dead code
advice-that-cannot-be-followed — ensure-npm-auth.sh and the hook both tell the reader to make AWS resolve a ref that surface_trust will always deny
docs-contradict-executable-truth — AGENTS.md asserts no lockfile and never npm ci while ci.yml does exactly that
local-commands-diverge-from-ci — verify:all cannot terminate and omits the blocking typecheck

governance-capability-not-reachable-from-session — the 51-skill corpus is delivered by a reconciler that only a project-scoped Cursor-Governance hook invokes; in a multi-repo workspace nothing runs it, so 47 skills were invisible and l9-plan had to be read off disk
two-registries-no-reconciliation — account-synced skills and the repo corpus overlap by only 4 of 51 and have drifted in both directions
deletions_or_consolidations: Delete the AWS-resolution advice from both the hook and ensure-npm-auth.sh rather than maintaining a path that policy guarantees will fail.
Consolidate four per-repo bespoke install workarounds into one governance link script.
Consolidate the package-to-source mapping into one declared data file instead of rediscovering it by find(1) each session.
Consolidate skill delivery onto the governance reconciler as SSOT instead of maintaining a divergent account-synced set.

risks.risk: Local sibling source drifts ahead of the published package, so local green stops predicting CI green.
risks.mitigation: The link script prints the local version against the package.json range for every package and warns on any mismatch; CI remains the authority and still installs published artifacts.

risks.risk: An agent mistakes linked local packages for a committable state and pushes a file: dependency.
risks.mitigation: The script writes only into gitignored node_modules and never edits package.json or package-lock.json; add a pre-commit assertion that no file: spec appears under dependencies.

risks.risk: Changing the SessionStart hook could stall sessions if a step blocks.
risks.mitigation: Preserve the existing soft-fail contract — every step guarded, always exit 0 — and cap the link step with a timeout.

risks.risk: T9 touches shared plugin setup and could affect other surfaces' skill availability.
risks.mitigation: Additive only: extend the sync list, do not remove entries; verify the synced manifest before and after.

risks.risk: Clearing 13 biome errors touches files unrelated to any feature and could mask a real defect while reformatting.
risks.mitigation: Land the biome cleanup as a standalone commit with no behavioral edits; require tsc + vitest green before and after and diff for logic changes.

risks.risk: User-scope $HOME/.claude/settings.json is container-local and is lost when the container is reclaimed.
risks.mitigation: Treat `make claude-install` as the durable path and document it as a one-time per-container step; the hook is an optimization, not the contract.
